name: zkFinance
rootCause: zkFinance was listed as a November 11, 2024 exploit on zkSync Era with about $200,000 in reported losses. The public record supports a Protocol Logic classification, but the exact flaw is not independently established in the consulted evidence. The exact technical flaw remains unverified in the consulted evidence. The public record only supports a Protocol Logic classification, and one secondary summary labels the event as an oracle misconfiguration exploit.
